title: Get to know Business Setup: Clinic Details, Clinic Preferences and more
summary: Tour of Clinic Details, Clinic Preferences, Patient Portal, Branches and Schedules: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Business Setup
steps.details: We'll go through Clinic Details, Clinic Preferences, Patient Portal, Branches and Schedules.

steps.title: Clinic Details
steps.details: It's the first thing to set up. The name and logo show on quotes, invoices, reminders and the patient portal; the main currency is the one for prices and the cash register. It has 3 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Clinic Preferences
steps.details: How things work: discounts, how payments and quotes behave and other settings that affect the whole team. It has 2 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Patient Portal
steps.details: Defines what the patient sees and can do online: book appointments, choose services, see prices, welcome message and video. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Branches
steps.details: Each branch groups its rooms and its office hours. Patients choose a branch when booking online and the team works with an active branch. It has 7 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Schedules
steps.details: Limits on which days and times appointments can be given at the branch. It's combined with each doctor's availability. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
